patterns: APPSC asks founder-to-body matches (Atmaram Pandurang = Prarthana Samaj, Derozio = Young Bengal) and body-to-work matches (Sharada Sadan, Satyashodhak, Arya Samaj).
APPSC also uses a description-to-body item: 'Poona 1849, caste + women's education' = Paramahansa Mandali. Other one-liners: Lokahitawadi = Gopal Hari Deshmukh; Jambhekar reformed Hinduism in Bombay.
AP tilt: Veeresalingam's first Andhra Prarthana Samaj at Rajahmundry (1878).
Other PSCs repeat Ranade = National Social Conference (alongside INC sessions), Tilak = Deccan Education Society and Paramahansa Mandali = Maharashtra.
The app matches these well but adds generic reform-body items (Deoband, Radhasoami, WPP, NCM/CDM) that stray from this topic.
